The system is specifically designed to filter oil-water mixtures (bilge water) generated during ship operations. An investigation is now underway against a 55-year-old ship's engineer for violating environmental regulations. The German-flagged vessel is temporarily not permitted to leave Bremerhaven. The entire bilge system and the oil separator must first be cleaned before the ship's departure.

evidence_excerpt: In Bremen Walle, on Thursday, a boy on his bicycle rode into a car while crossing a street. The 12-year-old fortunately sustained only minor injuries. A 60-year-old car driver was driving on Osterfeuerberger Ring in the direction of Waller Ring in the afternoon. According to current investigations, the 12-year-old boy simultaneously rode his mountain bike across the street at a red light and collided sideways with the car. The child hit his head against the windshield and subsequently lay briefly unconscious on the street. The boy was not wearing a protective helmet. After initial first aid by paramedics, he was taken to a hospital as a precautionary measure. According to the doctors, the boy was very lucky not to have suffered more severe injuries. Crossing the street is one of the main causes of accidents involving children. The police appeal to all parents to repeatedly discuss and practice correct road traffic behavior. For all motorized drivers: If you see children at the roadside, reduce your speed and be ready to brake. The police also advise all cyclists to wear a helmet. Modern helmets are very stable, light, and don't have to cost much. Of course, a helmet cannot prevent an accident, but it can significantly reduce severe injuries as consequences of an accident.
